title: Exchange two internal modules and close out an enclosure
instruction: Replace the grey storage sled and grey cooling module with the blue-marked replacements. Collect both removed modules in the grey tray. Seat the storage in its horizontal rails, fit the keyed cooling module, and close the lid.
context: The cooling shroud blocks storage removal, storage enters through capped rails, keyed cooler feet occupy a different interface, and lid closure retains the cooler. Correct replacement identities and collection of both removed parts are required.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body or cable-chain link; dimensions are collision envelopes. Shapes, local offsets, colors and joints are fully enumerated in scene.json. chassis: aluminium, 0.9 kg, envelope (0.22, 0.18, 0.06) m, origin (0.3, 0, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). lid: rigid engineering plastic, 0.18 kg, envelope (0.208, 0.174, 0.041) m, origin (0.4, 0, 0.8265), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). old_storage: rigid engineering plastic, 0.12 kg, envelope (0.127, 0.05, 0.03) m, origin (0.3, 0, 0.7655), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). old_cooler: rigid engineering plastic, 0.22 kg, envelope (0.138, 0.124, 0.045) m, origin (0.3, 0, 0.7955), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). new_storage: rigid engineering plastic, 0.12 kg, envelope (0.127, 0.05, 0.03) m, origin (0.24, -0.28, 0.7977), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). new_cooler: rigid engineering plastic, 0.22 kg, envelope (0.138, 0.124, 0.045) m, origin (0.25, -0.17, 0.7707), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). removed_parts: rigid engineering plastic, 0.5 kg, envelope (0.186, 0.214, 0.04) m, origin (0.4, -0.225, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). storage_source_stand: rigid material, 0.18 kg, envelope (0.12, 0.07, 0.042) m, origin (0.24, -0.28, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1).
scoring: 0.15 for old_cooler_collected; 0.15 for old_storage_collected; 0.25 for new_storage_seated; 0.25 for new_cooler_seated; 0.2 for service_closed_out. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 1.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero.
run_limit: 7200 control actions at 20 Hz (360 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid guide rails, keyed cooler feet and a passive gravity lid model handling and retention. Coarse fins identify the cooler but do not simulate heat transfer. Storage has no electrical or data function. Enlarged handles are part of the reproducible bench fixture. No automatic attachment is used.
